findings.title: Shell output redaction gap for unquoted password=/API-key prefixes
findings.impact: redact_shell_output only masked sk-/bearer/quoted-password patterns; unquoted password= and api_key= prefixes could survive in process output.
findings.mitigation: Fixed in Phase 26: redact_shell_output now composes the canonical core redactor (SE01 canary evidence passes).

findings.title: Symlink/junction escape test not executable on hosts without symlink privilege
findings.impact: On Windows hosts without Developer Mode, os.symlink raises WinError 1314; the SE04 symlink sub-observation is recorded N/A on that host.
findings.mitigation: PathSandbox enforces the boundary via resolve() on every platform; CI on Linux runs the full symlink case; junction escape is covered by the same resolve() boundary check.

findings.title: Authenticated live-browser security tests are nightly/manual only
findings.impact: Live Flow browser security scenarios are not run on every PR.
findings.mitigation: Mock-browser policy/state tests run in PR CI; controlled nightly smoke is bounded by the credit cap (plan §20.2).

findings.title: SSE/WebSocket cross-project event delivery is deployment-scoped
findings.impact: The event envelope carries project_id; the delivery channel must scope by project at the consumer boundary (SE11 demonstrates the check).
findings.mitigation: Project-scoped channel check enforced at the consumer; documented in audit_and_redaction.md.
